LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 7.1.1 PRESENTATION SKILLS – DEBATE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Presentation skills – Debate
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Presentation skills – Debate, part of Strand 7 in Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do we ensure that the audience follows a presentation? 2. Why are sports and games important in modern living?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work with peers to make a list of vocabulary related to sports and games,

2. work jointly to organise ideas based on the theme for a debate session,

3. prepare a mind map with supporting details for their position on the topic for debate,

4. discuss with peers the words and phrases used to introduce contrasting ideas in oral communication,

5. conduct a debating session on a topic related to the theme while applying appropriate audience awareness skills,

6. peer assess each other’s presentation for feedback. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with peers to make a list of vocabulary related to sports and games,
2. work jointly to organise ideas based on the theme for a debate session,
3. prepare a mind map with supporting details for their position on the topic for debate,
4. discuss with peers the words and phrases used to introduce contrasting ideas in oral communication,
5. conduct a debating session on a topic related to the theme while applying appropriate audience awareness skills,
6. peer assess each other’s presentation for feedback. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Presentation skills – Debate together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical Thinking and Problem-solving: The learner analyses concepts logically to prepare a mind map with supporting

details for their position on the topic for debate.

• Self-efficacy: This is attained as the learner shows concerted attention when conducting a debating session on a topic related

to the theme while applying appropriate audience awareness skills.

Values:
• Respect: This is instilled as the learner accommodates diverse opinions when conducting a debating session using

appropriate audience awareness skills.

• Peace: This is realised as the learner displays tolerance when discussing with peers the words and phrases used to introduce

contrasting ideas in oral communication.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social Cohesion: The learner interacts with information on sports and games, and debates around related topics with peers.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of debate and public speaking to their learning of presentation skills in English.
